column1: # Kurata F., Im K.U. (1971). Phase Equilibrium of Carbon Dioxide and Light Paraffins in Presence of Solid Carbon Dioxide.
# J. Chem. Eng. Data 16(3), 295-299. doi:10.1021/je60050a018. ACS copyright, owner-provided.
# Table VI, "Molal equilibrium ratios along S-V-L locus in carbon dioxide-methane system", p. 298, text layer checked against
# a 110 dpi page render. Footnote: "Based on data of Davis et al. (2)", i.e. Davis, Rodewald, Kurata 1962 (see
# davis-rodewald-kurata-1962-aiche-8-537.tsv); the pairing of liquid and vapour compositions at the same T is Kurata-Im's
# (interpolated/smoothed from Davis's separate x and y tables), NOT an independent measurement.
# Units as printed: T in deg F, p in psia, compositions in mole fraction, K = y/x. T_K and p_MPa derived here.
# Tables I to V (ternary and quaternary S-L-V data with ethane, propane, n-butane; Table I from Jensen) are NOT transcribed
# (outside the CO2 + CH4 / CO2 + CH4 + N2 scope of this task). There is no N2 system in this paper.
# Experimental uncertainty stated for Tables I to V (p. 296): T +-0.3 F (thermometer calibration better than +-0.1 F),
# p +-0.5 psia, composition maximum relative uncertainty +-3.2 %.
# Printed inconsistencies (not corrected): at -100.0 F the vapour sums to 1.0100 (K_CH4 1.150 implies y_CH4 0.9240); at
# -117.3 F the liquid sums to 0.9750 and the vapour to 0.9633 (K_CH4 1.092 implies y_CH4 0.9587 with x_CH4 0.8780).
# Sanity check: x_CO2 and y_CO2 decrease monotonically as T falls; p passes a maximum (703 psia) near -90 F, as in Davis.
# Digits as printed, one sanity check, not re-verified (owner: not looking for 100 % correct data).
# Role: G5 binary SLV phase compositions (derived from Davis 1962). Transcribed 2026-09-25, batch 2026-09-24-coolprop-low-temperature.
